templates.adminOnly: Only admins can create and edit templates.

list.title: Message templates
list.description: Create your WhatsApp templates, check how your customers will see them and submit them to Meta for approval. Only approved templates can be sent.
list.syncHint: Pull templates and their status from your WhatsApp Business account on Meta
list.syncTruncated: Meta has more templates than we could fetch. Contact support if any are missing.
list.emptyBody: WhatsApp only lets you message a customer freely within 24 hours of their last message. Outside that window, and for campaigns and reminders, you need templates approved by Meta.
list.submitError: Meta did not accept the template
list.submitInvalid: The template has fields to fix before submitting it
list.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
list.deleteBodyMeta: “{name}” will be deleted here and in your WhatsApp account on Meta. This cannot be undone.

editor.subtitle: Write your message, see how your customer will see it on WhatsApp and submit it to Meta for approval.
editor.readOnly: This template was already submitted to Meta. You can only edit drafts and rejected templates.
editor.rejectedTitle: Meta rejected this template. Fix it and submit it again.
editor.fixIssues: Check the highlighted fields before continuing

suggestion.title: Start from a suggestion
suggestion.description: Pick a model and adapt it to your business. It replaces what you have written.

basics.title: Basics
basics.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (_) only. It cannot be changed after submitting.
basics.nameLocked: (cannot be changed because it is already on Meta)
basics.channelHelp: The template is registered in this number's WhatsApp Business account.
basics.reclassify: Meta may change the category if it decides the content belongs to another one.
basics.languageHelp: Must be the language the message is written in. This exact code is used when sending.

auth.title: Verification code
auth.description: For authentication templates Meta writes the text: “{{1}} is your verification code…”, with a button to copy the code. You only choose how long the code lasts.
auth.expirationHelp: Between 1 and 90 minutes. Shown in the message footer.

header.title: Header
header.description: Optional. A short title or a file above the message.
header.textHelp: Up to 60 characters and a single variable.

limits.image: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.

header.sampleHelp: This is the sample Meta reviews; you can use a different file on each send.

badType.image: The image must be JPG or PNG
badType.document: The document must be a PDF

header.tooBig: The file exceeds the {max} MB limit

body.title: Message
body.description: The main text. Use variables to personalize it with each customer's data.
body.help: WhatsApp formatting: *bold*, _italic_, ~strikethrough~. The message cannot start or end with a variable.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Meta needs a sample of each variable to review the template. Also choose where the value comes from when sending.
variables.label: Name

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Optional. Small gray text at the end, no variables.
footer.label: Footer text

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Optional. Up to 10 buttons below the message.
buttons.limits: Up to 2 link buttons and 1 call button.

result.successBody: Meta usually replies within minutes, up to 24 h. You will see the result in the templates list.
result.errorTitle: Meta did not accept the template
result.errorBody: We saved it as a draft. This is Meta's message:

preview.title: Preview
preview.label: WhatsApp preview
preview.note: This is how your customer will see the message. The exact look may vary slightly by phone.

issues.name_format: The name on Meta can only contain lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
issues.name_taken: A template with this name and language already exists. Use another name.
issues.body_too_long: The message is longer than 1024 characters.
issues.variable_at_edge: The message cannot start or end with a variable. Add text before or after it.
issues.too_many_variables: Too many variables for the length of the text. Add more words or remove variables.
issues.header_required: Write the header text or choose “None”.
issues.header_too_long: The header is longer than 60 characters.
issues.header_one_variable: The header can only have one variable.
issues.footer_too_long: The footer is longer than 60 characters.
issues.button_text: Each button needs a text of up to 25 characters.
issues.button_url: The link must start with https:// (or http://) and have no spaces.
issues.button_url_example: Write a sample of the link's variable value.
issues.button_phone: Enter a valid phone number with country code (e.g. +1 555 123 4567).

errors.whatsapp_not_connected: Your WhatsApp number isn't connected. Connect it in Channels and try again.
errors.waba_missing: The channel is missing the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID. Reconnect the number from Channels.
errors.app_id_missing: Templates with an image, video or document need the platform's Meta App ID. Tell your administrator.
errors.media_not_found: We couldn't find the header file. Upload it again.
errors.media_upload_failed: Meta couldn't receive the header file. Try another file.
